_comment: Section 7's ticker: one line a night. Days 1-3 cozy, 4-7 unease, 8-9 dread. The bands overlap by a day so the turn does not land on a fixed date every run.

rumors.text: Prices are good in the plains, if you can get there.
The ford has not been this busy since the old bridge stood.
A carter swears he saw a white stag above the treeline. He had been drinking.
Salt is fetching double in Aldwath. Somebody is stockpiling.
Smoke over the eastern passes. Too much of it for a hearth.
Two Guild trains turned back rather than take the east road.
The Crown has pulled its patrols off the border and nobody will say why.
A woman came through with her children and no cart. She would not stop walking.
They are coming down the road. All of them.
Count your water. Count it again.
